required_operations: uncached native SQL readback of declared logical projection
consistency: eventual native query visibility; fenced acknowledged IDs and selected values must reconcile
batch_atomicity: not claimed; partial OTLP acceptance leaves the full source batch ambiguous
idempotency: not claimed; source uses no automatic retries; duplicate returned copies are counted and fail healthy qualification
durability: native local WAL/filesystem settings; HTTP ACK is not assumed to mean power-loss durability
delete_ttl: not exercised; stream retention initially inherits native defaults, to be normalized/read back before a retention comparison
selected_log_fields: exact body bytes, source ID, native trace/span correlation, severity, tenant, timestamp, resource and scope
selected_metric_fields: exact point identity, timestamp/value, metric name and business/resource/scope labels
selected_trace_fields: IDs/parents, service, tenant, names/kinds/status/message, start/end, microsecond duration, logical numeric attributes, events and links

native_trace_projection.integer_span_and_event_attributes: decimal strings in the native SQL representation
native_trace_projection.ordinary_trace_scope: absent from the default stored trace schema
native_trace_projection.main_span_trace_state: absent from the default stored trace schema
native_trace_projection.main_span_flags: pinned source hardcodes 1; alternate flags unqualified
native_trace_projection.events_links: JSON strings; verify their selected parsed fields

oracle: explicit use_cache=false on native search; reject partial/result-cached responses, wrong values, missing ACKs and duplicate returned copies; preserve histories across faults
limits: logical projection qualification is not lossless OTLP export, physical duplicate inventory, HA, independent backup or power-loss qualification
